[{"id": "nnvMTG5Sl5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udc65People Manual", "col": 12}}, {"id": "B-CtTCmVDX", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The people module contains features relating to the people of the church (i.e. Members, Families, Leadership. etc).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Htx875Wd1w", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The People workspace contains number cards and graphs indicating the current count of people/families/members. there are also links to various reports (Birthdays, Roles, Letters, etc).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "qI9ZNpJJX4", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udc64Person", "col": 12}}, {"id": "RZThk3_x4O", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Church people include guests, members, leadership, and other people who interact or are associated with the church.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "UJEDTpYJIM", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When adding a person, note the following:
- Church membership and baptism status can be indicated.
    - If needed, additional member status types can be created.
- If the person has any roles in the church, they should be indicated in the 'Positions' section. 
   - If a position type does not exist, you can create new role types as needed.
- Photos should be added for members. The photos will be used in a member directory in a future versions.
- An email address or phone number may be on one person only, which stops the same person being entered twice. Phone numbers match however they are written, so '(202) 555-0147' and '202.555.0147' are the same number.
    - When two people really use the same one, such as a couple's shared email or a child using a parent's phone, enter it on both people and leave 'Shared From' blank on the owner's row, usually the person who uses it to sign in to the portal. On everyone else's row, set 'Shared From' to the owner: the list offers only the people who already have that email or phone. Any number of people may share one email or phone this way.
    - A family may use a member's email or phone without setting 'Shared From'.
- Letters from this person can be added in the 'Contact' tab
- Tick 'Hide from Directory' to leave a person out of the printed Church Directory. Members can tick it themselves on their Personal Details page in the portal.
- If a family has been selected, the person will be displayed in the \"Family Members\" section on the `Family` form.
- Family relationships can be defined in the 'Family' tab.
    - When a spouse is added, the spouse's document is linked back, the anniversary is shared, and a Husband/Wife row is added to the 'Relations' table of both people. On the Family form, the head of household's spouse is labelled Husband/Wife in the members list.
    - When a spouse is added, the couple shares one family. If only one of them has a family, the other joins it. If neither has one, a family named after the person being saved is created, with that person as head of household. If they are in different families, no one is moved.
    - A member's spouse who has no 'Relationship to Head' gets one from the member: a Son's wife is a Daughter-in-law, a Daughter's husband is a Son-in-law, and a Brother's wife is a Sister-in-law.
    - The 'Relations' table fills in the rest of the family from each member's 'Relationship to Head' on the Family and their gender. For example, two people marked Son are each other's Brother, and the head's spouse is their Mother or Father. These rows have 'From Family' ticked and are updated whenever the person or the family is saved. When someone leaves the family, the rows to and from them stay and lose the 'From Family' tick, because the relationships are still true. Deleting a person or a family removes its rows.
    - When a relation cannot be worked out (no 'Relationship to Head', gender Unknown, or a pair such as two grandchildren who may be siblings or cousins), no row is added and the form names the family members who are missing.
    - Add a row by hand for anyone else, or to correct a 'From Family' row untick 'From Family' and change the type. Rows without 'From Family' are never changed.
    - When both people are in the same family, the other person's 'From Family' row follows a row entered by hand. For example, Stepbrother on Bob's form gives Bob as Stepbrother on Bill's form. When the type has no known reverse, such as a type the church added itself, the other person's row is removed and their form names the missing person.
    - A Family can be automatically created from a person by clicking the 'New Family From Person' button. This requires a 'Last Name' to be set, and will set the person as the Family's head-of-household. The button is there for anyone who is not already a head of household, so a married son can start his own family.
    - When a married person moves to another family, their spouse moves with them if the spouse was in the same family.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "IqJm62Jfo2", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To give a person access to the Church App Portal, the church person must have an associated email address. 
Click the \"Invite to Portal\" button on the 'Person' form to create and associate a new user with the 'Person'.
    - The user will be created with 'Church User' permissions and linked with the 'Person' (This should give the user access to their own information as well as information that is shared with them).
    - The user should receive an invitation/welcome email (assuming email settings have been setup correctly).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "staffroles1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Staff logins", "col": 12}}, {"id": "staffroles2", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Portal access is for members. Staff and volunteers who work in the desk need a user with a Role Profile that matches their job:
- Church Staff: looks up people, events, groups and ministries, and keeps their own prayer requests, sign-ups and room bookings.
- Church Office: also adds and edits people, families, groups and member transfers.
- Church Care Team: also handles care, counseling, visitation, background checks, and prayer and alms requests.
- Church Treasurer: also handles collections, expenses, funds, budgets and giving statements.
- Church Check-In Volunteer: uses the Check-In Station only.
- Church Manager: everything, including settings.

To give someone several jobs, add more than one Role Profile to their user. Each person only sees the workspaces, reports and dashboards their roles can use.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "TZBrYvFWti", "type": "header", "data": {"text": "Visitations", "col": 12}}, {"id": "SJPiHfoARN", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Visitations are visit of a person by a church representative. 
When adding a visitation, note the following:
-  The visitation type can be changed, or new visitation types can be added.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "A37CU_rUFj", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udc68\u200d\ud83d\udc69\u200d\ud83d\udc67\u200d\ud83d\udc66Family", "col": 12}}, {"id": "_wxytNqTX4", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Families are groups of people who are related.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "qQr_8PsoeH", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When adding a family, note the following:
- After adding a family, you may want to link people to the family. When a person is linked to a family, that person will be displayed in the \"Family Members\" list.
- Only one person can be set as the head of household. To set the head-of-household, go to the person's document and check 'Is Head of Household' on the 'Family' tab.
", "col": 12}}, {"id": "GrpSection1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udc65Group", "col": 12}}, {"id": "GrpSection2", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Groups are collections of people with a related purpose (e.g. Sunday School classes, ministries, small groups, committees, etc.).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "GrpSection3", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When adding a group, note the following:
- Check 'Public' if anyone can join the group. (Users can join public groups in the portal.)
- Check 'Show in Portal' if users should be able to see their group membership in the portal.
- Members can be added in the 'Members' section. Each member is assigned a Group Role (e.g. Leader, Member).
- A group can be linked to a Ministry via the Ministry form.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "0a0Yfbfao3", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udcd4 Church Directory", "col": 12}}, {"id": "aIL5EgTGiJ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To generate a Church Directory:
1. Navigate to People > Church Directory
2. Select which options you want for the report. They are in groups, and the directory preview is updated after each selection:
    - People:
        - Members Only: This will filter out any non-members from the directory.
        - Group by Family: This will list each family together under the family name. When it is off, each person is listed by name.
        - People with 'Hide from Directory' ticked are always left out, with their birthday and their anniversary. A family whose head of household is hidden is listed by its surname only, such as 'Doe Family' for 'Doe - John'. A family whose members are all hidden is left out.
    - Show:
        - Photos: This will display available photos in the directory.
        - Positions: This will show the person's church position under their name in the directory
        - Membership Status: This will show the person's membership status next to their name.
        - Head of Household: This will mark the person that is designated as the Family's head of household.
    - Contact Details:
        - Phone Numbers: This will show each person's primary phone number.
        - Emails: This will show each person's primary email address, and the email address of each missionary.
        - Addresses: This will show each family's primary address. A family member whose own primary address is different shows it under their name. A person without a family, and every person when Group by Family is off, shows their own primary address, or their family's when they have none.
    - Extra Pages:
        - Birthday List: This will include a list of all the people's birthdays near the end of the directory.
        - Anniversary List: This will include a list of people's anniversaries near the end of the directory.
        - Missionaries: This will include a list of missionaries at the end of the directory. If the missionary is marked as 'sensitive', only the name, photo, and agency will be shown. A person in a listed missionary's People table is left out of the family and individual pages, so they are not shown twice.
        - Notes Page: This will add a lined page at the end of the directory for handwritten notes.
    - Printing:
        - Church Image on Cover: This will show the church's image, such as a logo, on the cover. Set the image on the Church record.
        - Page Numbers: This will number each page in its outer bottom corner. The cover is not numbered.
        - Booklet: This will make the PDF a half-size booklet. Each side of a letter sheet holds two pages, in the order that lets you fold the stack in half. The cover is on the front and the back cover is always blank, so the Blank Back Cover option is hidden. A booklet needs a multiple of four pages, so blank pages are added before the Notes page. The Notes page stays just inside the back cover.
        - Blank Back Cover: This will add an empty last page, so the back of the directory stays blank.
3. Click 'Print Directory' to open the directory as a PDF, then print it from there. For a booklet, print double-sided and flip on the short edge. Then keep the sheets in order and fold them in half.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "dirCover01", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The cover shows the church's name, address, website, mission statement and Church Verse, taken from the Church record. The website is left off when the Web Site module is turned off in Church Features. The verse text is printed in the church's Default Bible Translation when that translation's text is available; otherwise only the reference is printed.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "rolodex_h", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udcc7Rolodex", "col": 12}}, {"id": "rolodex_b1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Rolodex is the quickest way to look someone up and get in touch, on a computer or a phone. Every person is a card, sorted by last name. Every staff login can open it from the People workspace, or with the Rolodex button on the Person and Family lists. The Family list opens it showing households.
- Type in the search box to find a name, family, phone number or email address.
- Tap a letter down the side, or drag your finger along the letters, to jump through the alphabet.
- Use the buttons on the front of a card to call, text, email or map the person.
- Tap a card to turn it over. The back shows their positions, groups, birthday, anniversary, membership and address, with an Open link to their record.
- Switch to Households to see one card per family. People without a family keep a card of their own.
- Click Filters to narrow the cards by membership, group or position, and by church when your site has more than one. Each filter you pick shows as a tag under the search box; click its \u2715 to remove it. On a computer the filters sit beside the cards and can be hidden; on a phone they slide up from the bottom.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "rolodex_b2", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Saving cards
Tap the bookmark on a card to save it, for example to build a list of everyone to call this week. Saved cards get a ribbon and gather in a tray at the bottom of the page. On a household card, the bookmark at the top saves the whole family, and each person has a bookmark of their own.
- Your saved cards stay with your login, so a list built on a computer is waiting on your phone.
- From the tray you can Email everyone saved (their addresses go in BCC, so no one sees the others), Print their cards, or Add to Group if you can edit groups. Clear empties the tray.
- Save all, Email all and Print above the cards work on everyone your search and filters are showing.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "mt_h", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udce8Member Transfers", "col": 12}}, {"id": "mt_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Member Transfers record people transferring into or out of the church.
- Set the Direction (In/Out), the other church, and update the Status as the transfer progresses.
- A 'Letter of Transfer' can be printed from the form.
- With multi-church on, a move between your own branches is a transfer with a To Church: confirming it moves the person (and their portal access) to that branch.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "cr_h", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83e\udd1dCare Requests", "col": 12}}, {"id": "cr_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Care Requests capture 'need help' submissions from members (meal help, hospital, grief, etc.). Members can submit them from the portal.
- When a person is selected, 'Assigned To' is pre-filled from their Care Assignment if one exists.
- New Care Request Types can be added as needed.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "bgc_h", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udee1\ufe0fBackground Checks", "col": 12}}, {"id": "bgc_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Background Checks record the screenings a person has had so leaders can see who is cleared to serve. Churchit does not run the check itself: order it from whichever provider your church uses, then record the result here.
- Pick the person and the Background Check Type (Criminal Background, Sex Offender Registry, Child Abuse Clearance, Driving Record, or your own). Each type sets how many years a cleared check stays valid.
- Note the provider and their reference number so the report can be found on their site. The report itself can be attached.
- Move the status from Requested to Pending to Cleared or Not Cleared as the check progresses. A completed date is required for a result.
- Expires On is filled in from the type's validity when a completed date is entered, and can be changed. Cleared checks are marked Expired automatically once that date passes.
- The most recent check is shown at the top of the Person form, and all of a person's checks are listed under Connections.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ca_h", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udc65Care Assignments", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ca_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Care Assignments map a person to a deacon or care-team member for a date range. An assignment is considered active while the current date falls within its start/end dates.", "col": 12}}]
